name: Sorry About the Mess
text: When building a Command Hand, treat this card as though it has 1 Pip. When Han Solo is issued an Order with this card, he gains 1 Aim token and 1 Dodge token.

name: A Higher Purpose
text:
At the start of Bo-Katan Kryzeʼs next Activation, she may make a Recover action.
Bo-Katan Kryze gains Barrage and Relentless this Round. Additionally, while Bo-Katan Kryze is Engaged this Round, her weapons gain Pierce 1.

name: A Simple Man
text:
At the start of the next Activation Phase, if Boba Fett has a faceup Order token, an allied unit within Range 1 of Boba Fett may make a Speed-1 Move.
Otherwise, Boba Fett gains 1 Aim token and, until the end of the Round, increases the Range of his Ranged weapons by 1 to a maximum of 5 and gains Marksman.

name: Ace Up His Sleeve
text:
While building a Command Hand, treat this card as though it has 2 pips.
If this card is in your Command Hand, during the Resolve Command Card Effects step of the Command Phase, after revealing Command Cards but before resolving Command Card effects, you may return your revealed card to your Command Hand and play this card instead. Treat this card as having been selected, played, and revealed instead of that card.

name: AI Coordination
text: When a unit is issued an Order with this card, it gains 1 Standby token.

name: Arboreal Assault
text:
You must nominate an Ewok Commander.
If you cannot nominate an Ewok Commander, you cannot play this card.
When a Ewok Trooper unit is issued an Order with this card, its weapons gain Suppressive and Immobilize 1 until the end of the Round.
Additionally, when an allied Special Forces unit makes an attack against an enemy unit that has a faceup Order token, after the attack is resolved, shuffle that Order token back into that player's Order Pool.

name: Architects of Their Own Destruction
text:
At the start of the Activation Phase, choose an enemy unit. If the chosen unit does not have a faceup Order token, assign it a faceup Order token from your opponent's Order Pool, if able.
The first time your opponent chooses to activate a unit this Round, they may choose to activate the chosen unit. If they do not, the chosen unit may not activate using a faceup Order token until your Opponent has no Order tokens in their Order Pool or on Command Cards, and has no other units with faceup Order tokens.

name: At Last
text:
While building a Command Hand, treat this card as though it has 3 pips.
Maul gains 1 Aim token and gains Jedi Hunter this Round. At the start of Maulʼs next Activation, he may suffer 1 Wound.

name: Blast Off!
text:
This Round, R2-D2 increases his maximum Speed by 1 and gains Disengage and [Action] Jump 1.
When R2-D2 is issued an Order with this card, R2-D2 gains 1 Dodge token and 1 Suppression token.

name: Bring It Down!
text:
During his next Activation, Clone Commander Cody may make his [Free action] actions up to 2 times.
This Round, each time an allied unit declares an attack against an enemy unit that has 1 or more Observation tokens, the allied unit may spend 1 of those tokens. If it does, that attack gains Suppressive if the enemy unit is a Trooper unit, or Impact 1 if the enemy unit is a Vehicle unit.

name: Brutal Enforcer
text:
At the start of the Activation Phase, choose up to 2 allied Geonosian Warrior units within Range 2 of Sun Fac. Each chosen unit may [Action] Jump 3.
Sun Fac gains Agile 1 and Demoralize 1 this Round.

name: Call Me Captain
text: Once per Activation this Round while Clone Captain Rex has a faceup Order token, when another allied unit attacks an enemy unit within Range 2 and in LOS of Clone Captain Rex, add 3 red attack dice to the allied unit's Attack Pool during the Form Attack pool step.

name: Close Call
text: At the start of the next Activation Phase, Wicket gains 1 Dodge token. Until the end of the Round, Wicket increases his maximum Speed to 3 and gains Outmaneuver. Wicket cannot make attacks this Round.

name: Come and Prove It
text: This Round, Fifth Brother and Seventh Sister gain Indomitable and roll 1 extra defense die during the Roll Defense Die step while they are defending. Until the end of the Round, each time Seventh Sister is declared as the target of an attack, if she has a faceup Order token, she gains 1 Dodge token at the start of the Apply Dodge and Cover step.

name: Common Cause
text: At the end of Chewbacca's next Activation, if Luke Skywalker has a faceup Order token, he may activate. At the end of Luke Skywalker's next Activation, if Chewbacca has a faceup Order token, he may activate.

name: Coordinated Bombardment
text: At the end of Leia Organa's next Activation, she may make up to 3 attacks against different enemy units using the weapon below.

name: Corellian Spike
text:
At the start of Lando Calrissian's next Activation, he may choose up to 1 enemy unit within Range 2 and in LOS. If he does, roll 2 red attack dice and resolve the effect shown below for each matching result:
Blank: The chosen unit gains 2 Immobilize tokens.
[hit] or [hit surge]: The chosen unit gains 1 Immobilize token.
[crit]: Lando Calrissian gains 2 Immobilize tokens.
Divulge: Resolve Setup Effects step. Lando Calrissian gains Infiltrate and Incognito this Game.

name: Covert Observation
text: When an enemy unit is issued an Order with a Command Card this Round, that unit gains 1 Suppression token.

name: Crack Shot
text: Cassian Andor gains 1 Aim token, gains Gunslinger this Round, and may gain 1 Suppression token. During Cassian Andorʼs next Activation, he may make a free Attack action.

name: Defiance
orders: 1 Special Forces Unit or Support Unit
text: When an allied unit is issued an Order with this card, if a Commander Wookiee Trooper unit issued that Order, and if the Ordered unit has 1 or more Wound tokens or has had 1 or more of its miniatures be defeated, the Ordered unit gains 1 Aim token, 1 Dodge token, and 1 Surge token.

name: Delaying Tactics
text: At the end of this Command Phase, choose an opponent. The chosen opponent must choose 1 of their non- Commander units that has a faceup Order token, if able, and return that unit's Order token to their Order Pool.

name: Die at My Hand
text: Moff Gideon gains 1 Aim token and 1 Dodge token and gains Relentless this Round.

name: Drive Them Out
text: Allied Vehicles gain Demoralize 1 this Round. The first time an allied Vehicle that has a faceup Order token ends a Move within Range ½ of 1 or more enemy units this Round, choose 1 of those units. Roll 1 white defense die for each miniature in the chosen unit. The chosen unit suffers 1 Wound for every [defense surge] or [block] result in the roll.

name: Duel of the Fates
text: Maul gains 1 Dodge token and gains Disengage this Round. While Maul is Engaged with an enemy unit this Round, that unit cannot spend Aim tokens, Dodge tokens, Standby tokens, or Surge tokens.

name: Explosions!
text:
Permanent. During the Round in which this card was played, Sabine Wren gains [Action] Arm 2: Thermal Charge. After Sabine Wren makes this action, she may make a Speed-1 Move.
Until the end of the Game, Sabine Wren gains Detonate 2: Thermal Charge. Do not discard this card from play.

name: Exterminate
text:
When Super Tactical Command Droid is issued an Order with this card, it gains Demoralize 2 this Round.
Additionally, the first time this Round the Ordered Super Tactical Command Droid defeats an enemy unit, after the effect is resolved, that Super Tactical Command Droid may make a free Attack action, even if it has already made an Attack action during its Activation.

name: Face Me!
text:
Agent Kallus gains Hold the Line this Round.
Additionally, until the end of the Round, enemy Trooper units that are Engaged with Agent Kallus cannot Move, except to Pivot.

name: Fear, Surprise, Intimidation
text: This Round, Count Dooku gains Arsenal 2 and Relentless and each of his Ranged weapons gains Versatile. Until the end of the Round, each time Count Dooku makes an attack, after the attack is resolved, each defending unit gains 2 Suppression tokens.

name: Fearsome Oration
text: When an Imperial Agent is issued an order with this card, it gains Demoralize 2 and Inspire 2 until the end of the Round.

name: Flow of the Force
orders: Jedi Knight or Jedi Knight General
requirementText: Jedi Knight or Jedi Knight General
text: When a unit is issued an Order with this card, it may make a Recover action. Then it gains 1 Aim token, 1 Dodge token, and 1 Standby token.

name: Focused on the Kill
text:
Permanent. When IG-88 makes an attack against a unit that has 1 or more Bounty tokens, the defending unit cannot spend tokens during that attack.
IG-88 is not defeated when he is assigned Wound tokens equal to his Wound threshold.
At the start of the End Phase, if IG-88 has a number of Wound tokens equal to or exceeding his Wound threshold, he is defeated.

name: For the Cause
text:
You must nominate a Commander unit as Commander to play this card.
When a unit is issued an Order with this card, it gains 1 Surge token.

name: Go, There Are Too Many...
text:
Permanent. This card may only be selected if Paz Vizsla is within Range 2 of 2 or more enemy units.
Paz Vizsla changes is courage to "–", gains 1 Standby token, gains Stationary, and his weapons gain Versatile. Additionally, when Paz Vizsla spends a Standby token, after the effect is resolved, he may suffer 1 Wound. If he does, he gains 1 Standby token.

name: Gunner, Infantry!
text: Until the end of the Round, Major Marquand gains Tactical 1 and his weapons gain Suppressive. During his next Activation, Major Marquand reduces his maximum Speed by 1, to a minimum of 1.

name: Hello There!
text:
Obi-Wan Kenobi gains Nimble this Round.
At the start of the next Activation Phase, Obi-Wan Kenobi may gain 1 Aim token, 1 Dodge token, 1 Standby token, or 1 Surge token for each enemy unit within Range 2.

name: I Am No Jedi
text: Ahsoka Tano gains Agile 1 this Round. Until the end of the Round, each time Ahsoka Tano makes an attack, during the Form Attack Pool step, add 1 white die to the Attack Pool for each Dodge token that she has, to a maximum of 3.

name: I Have Graphs AND the Command
text:
General Tagge may remove any number of tokens from Logistical Prowess to gain the matching tokens.
At the start of the Activation Phase, General Tagge may make a Speed-2 move.

name: I Rebel
text: Jyn Erso gains Charge during her next Activation. Once this Round, when an enemy unit within Range 2 and in LOS of Jyn Erso starts its Activation, before its Rally step, Jyn Erso may gain 1 Suppression token. If she does, she may make a free Move action, and then may make a free Attack action.

name: I'll Do it Myself!
text:
You may choose an allied Droid Trooper unit within Range 1 of General Grievous. If you do, the chosen unit suffers 1 Wound and General Grievous gains Tactical 1 this Round.
When General Grievous makes attacks this Round, remove all Aim tokens, Dodge tokens, Surge tokens, and Standby tokens from the defending unit during the Form Attack Pool step.

name: I'm Your Worst Nightmare
text: Cad Bane gains Uncanny Luck 2 this Round. During Cad Baneʼs Activation this Round, he can make up to 2 Attack actions instead of the normal 1.

name: Implacable
text:
At the start of each of Darth Vader's Activations this Round, he gains 1 Dodge token. At the end of Darth Vader's first Activation this Round, he may suffer 1 Wound.
If he does, shuffle his Order token into the Order Pool. During Darth Vader's second Activation this Round, he makes 1 fewer action.

name: Into the Breach
text:
This Round, when Obi-Wan Kenobi ends a Move Contesting a POI Objective token, he gains 1 Aim token and 1 Dodge token.
Additionally, during his next Activation, Obi-Wan Kenobi gains the weapon below.

name: Lead from the Front
text: When building a Command Hand, treat this card as though it has 2 pips. When an allied Commander is issued an Order with this card, choose up to 3 other allied units within Range 1 of that Commander unit. Each chosen unit gains 1 Aim token or 1 Dodge token.

name: Let the Executions Begin!
text: This Round, each time an allied Corps Trooper unit makes an attack, if the defending unit is within Range 2 and in LOS of Poggle the Lesser during the Roll Attack Dice step, the attacking unit gains [hit surge]: [crit] during that attack.

name: Log Traps
text: At the start of the Activation Phase this Round, 1 Ewok Trooper unit that contains an Ewok Trapper miniature may make an attack using the weapon below.

name: Marked For Elimination
text: When Gar Saxon is issued an Order with this card, he gains 2 Aim tokens. Then choose an enemy Commander or Operative unit. The chosen unit gains 4 Observation tokens and 2 Suppression tokens.

name: Maximum Firepower
text: At the end of General Veersʼ next Activation, he may make an attack using the weapon below.

name: Mechanical Carnage
text:
IG-11 loses Gunslinger this Round.
The first time IG-11 declares an Attack action during his next Activation, he makes 1 attack against each enemy unit within Range 2 and in LOS instead of attacking normally.

name: Mechanized Incursion
text: When an allied Vehicle unit is issued an Order this Round, choose an allied Droid Trooper unit within Range 2 of that Vehicle. The chosen unit issues an Order to itself.

name: Merciless Munitions
text: Permanent. During the Round this card is played, Bossk gains [Action] Arm 1: Dioxis Charge. After Bossk makes this action, he may make a Speed-1 Move. Until the end of the Game, Bossk gains Detonate 1: Dioxis Charge. After a Trooper unit defends against a Dioxis Charge attack, that unit gains 1 Poison token. Do not discard this card from play.

name: Moment of Triumph
text:
You must Divulge this card.
Divulge: Resolve Setup Effects step.
Permanent. Darth Vader gains Guardian 4: Grand Moff Tarkin and can benefit from Backup. While defending, Grand Moff Tarkin can benefit from Backup provided by Darth Vader even if the attacking unitʼs unit leader is within Range 2 of Grand Moff Tarkin.
While Grand Moff Tarkin is Contesting an Objective token that is not in allied Territory, allied Trooper units within Range 2 of him have Disciplined 1.

name: Never Tell me the Odds
text:
Han & Chewie may issue an Order to themselves. At the start of Han & Chewieʼs next Activation, if they are Holding or Contesting 1 or more Objective tokens, they gain 2 Aim tokens and Marksman during that Activation.
At the end of Han & Chewieʼs next Activation, if they are Holding or Contesting 1 or more Objective tokens, they gain 2 Dodge tokens and may remove all of their Suppression tokens.

name: No Escape
text:
When a unit is issued an Order with this card attacks this Round, the defending unit may not spend any Dodge or Surge tokens during that attack.
Additionally, while a unit that was issued an Order with this card is Engaged with an enemy unit this Round, that enemy unit cannot spend Aim tokens, Dodge tokens, or Surge tokens.

name: No One Threatens Our Family
orders: 1 Clan Wren Commander or Clan Wren Operative
text:
Allied Clan Wren Commander and Clan Wren Operative units gain Guardian 1: Clan Wren until the end of the Round.
Additionally, when an allied Clan Wren unit uses Guardian X this Round, after the effect is resolved, choose an allied Clan Wren unit within Range 1 of that unit. The chosen unit gains 1 Aim token.

name: Our Fate is in Your Hands
text:
Padmé Amidala gains Danger Sense 2 this Round. At the start of the next Activation Phase, allied Trooper units within Range 2 of Padmé Amidala may remove any number of Suppression tokens. Then, for each Suppression token removed in this way, Padmé Amidala gains 1 Suppression token.
Finally, for each Suppression token she gained in this way, she gains 1 Dodge token, to a maximum of 2 Dodge tokens.

name: Ploy
text: This Round, at the start of the Activation Phase, choose 1 Order token from your Order Pool and place it face down on this card. Then shuffle your Order Pool. You may look at this token at any time. This Round, when you would draw an Order token from your Order Pool, you may use the Order token on this card instead.

name: Pulse Scan
text:
Iden Versio gains 1 Aim token and gains Sharpshooter 2 this Round.
At the end of Iden Versio's next Activation, she gains 1 Dodge token and 1 Standby token.

name: Sabotaged Communications
text: When an opponent issues Orders using a Command Card this Round, they can issue only 1 Order with that card.

name: See You in Hell
text:
Permanent. Han Solo gains Unconcerned and Unstoppable.
During the Round in which this card was played, Han Solo gains Disengage and gains 1 Aim token, 1 Dodge token, and cannot be Suppressed or Panicked.

name: Size Matters Not
text:
This Round, Yoda gains Jump 1, Charge, Disengage, and treats his maximum Speed as 3.
During his next Activation, Yoda can make any of his [Action] or [Free action] up to 2 times.
At the start of the next End Phase, if There Is No Try is in your discard pile, return it to your Command Hand.

name: Sneak Attack
text: Divulge: Setup. Choose up to 2 Corps Clone Trooper units. Each chosen unit gains Infiltrate this game. Then, for each Special Forces unit in your army, choose a different Vehicle unit. Each chosen Vehicle unit gains Scout 1 this Game.

name: Son of Skywalker
text: When Luke Skywalker makes his first attack this Round, after the attack sequence is resolved, he may make a free attack action, even if he has already made an attack action that Turn.

name: Synchronized Offensive
text: When an allied Vehicle unit is issued an Order with this card, choose an allied Clone Trooper unit within Range 2 of that Vehicle. The nominated Commander issues the chosen unit an Order.

name: The Jedi Shall Fall
text: Asajj Ventress gains Jedi Hunter this Round. Until the end of the Round, each time Asajj Ventress makes an attack, during the Roll Attack Dice step, she may gain up to 4 Suppression tokens before rolling dice. She gains 1 Dodge token for each Suppression token gained in this way.

name: They Too Will Suffer
text:
At the end of the Command Phase, choose an opponent. The chosen opponent must choose 1 of their Corps, Special Forces, Support, or Heavy units with a faceup Order token, if able, and return that Order token to their Order Pool.
The first time the chosen opponent would draw an Order token from their Order Pool this Round, you may force them to draw a token with a Rank of your choice instead.

name: This is the Way
text: Din Djarin gains 1 Dodge token and gains Relentless this Round.

name: This Is Where the Fun Begins
text:
Anakin Skywalker gains [Free action] Jump 2 this Round. During Anakin Skywalker's next Activation, he can make up to 2 Attack Actions
Divulge: Resolve Setup Effects step. Anakin Skywalker gains Prepared Position this game

name: This Party's Over
text:
When Mace Windu is issued and Order with this card, he may suffer 1-3 Wounds.
This Round, when Mace Windu would use the Vaapad Mastery keyword while he is Engaged, add red attack or defense dice instead of white attack or defense dice.

name: Trained in Your Jedi Arts
text: General Grievous gains 1 Dodge token and gains Disengage this Round. At the end of General Grievousʼ next Activation he may make an attack against each enemy unit within Range 1 and in LOS using the weapon below.

name: Unrelenting Fire
text: This Round, each enemy unit cannot remove more than 1 Suppression token during its Rally step.

name: Vader's Might
text:
This Round, Darth Vader gains the following free action.
[Free action] Choose another non- Heavy unit within Range 1.
Place the chosen unitʼs unit leader on the battlefield within Range ½ and within Height 1 of its current position. Then place the rest of the chosen unit in cohesion with the unit leader.
Then, if it is an enemy unit, roll 1 white defense die for each miniature in the unit. That unit suffers 1 Wound for each [block] and [defense surge] result in the roll.

name: Voracious Ambition
text: At the start of this Roundʼs Activation Phase, place 3 random Order tokens from your Order Pool face down on this card. You may look at these Order tokens at any time. When you would draw an Order token from your Order Pool, you may choose 1 of the Order tokens on this card and use that token instead.

name: We Are Mandalorians
text:
When a unit is issued an Order with this card, it gains Inspire 2 this Round and may make a Speed-1 Move.
This Round, when a unit issued an Order by this card attacks, during the Form Attack Pool step it may add X black attack dice to 1 of its Attack Pools to a maximum of 5, where X is the number of Suppression tokens on other allied Mandalorian Trooper units within Range 2 of the attacking unit.

name: We Shall Start with Revenge
text:
Savage Opress may suffer up to the current Round number in Wounds. Then, for each Wound token Svage Opress has, Savage Opress gains 1 Aim token. Finally, for each Wound token Maul has, Maul gains 1 Aim token.
Choose 1 of Maul's Command Cards in your Discard pile, if able. Return the chosen Command Card to your Command Hand.

name: Whipcord Launcher
text:
This Round, while Boba Fett is Engaged, he can make Moves as normal if any unit he is Engaged with has 1 or more Immobilize tokens. During Boba Fettʼs next Activation, he gains the following free action.
[Free action] Choose an enemy Trooper unit within Range 1 and in LOS. The chosen unit gains 2 Immobilize tokens and 2 Suppression tokens.

name: Wisdom of the Council
text: At the start of the next Activation Phase, roll 5 red attack dice. For each [crit] and [hit surge] result rolled, issue an Order to an allied Republic unit that does not have a faceup Order token. For each [hit] result rolled, 1 allied unit may remove 1 Suppression token. For each Blank result rolled, 1 allied unit may gain 1 Aim token or 1 Dodge token.

name: You Are Beaten
text:
Ahsoka Tano gains Charge this Round.
If she defeats 1 or more enemy units this Round, she can make up to 2 attack actions and may make a free Move action during her Activation this Round. When Ahsoka Tano attacks an enemy unit with a Melee attack this Round, after that attack is resolved, the defending unit may make a free Move action and can Withdraw with that action.

name: You Serve Your Master Well
text:
This Round, Luke Skywalker gains the following free action.
[Free action] Choose an allied non- Commander, non- Operative Trooper unit within Range 1, or a Suppressed enemy non- Commander, non- Operative Trooper unit within Range 1.
If the chosen unit is an allied unit, make 1 free Move or Attack action with that unit. If the chosen unit is an enemy unit, it gains 3 Suppression tokens.

name: A Beautiful Friendship
text: Permanent. Wicket gains Teamwork: Leia Organa. When an Ewok Commander issues Orders, you may choose an allied Rebel unit within Range 1 of that Commander and that Commander issues the chosen unit an Order. When a Rebel Commander issues Orders, you may choose an allied Ewok unit within Range 1 of that Commander and that Commander issues the chosen unit an Order.

name: A Disturbance in the Force
text:
This Round, while a unit issued an Order with this card has a faceup Order token, it has Danger Sense 1 and Indomitable.
Until the end of the Round, when an allied unit with 1 or more Force upgrade slots spends or loses a Standby token this Round, after the effect is resolved, that unit gains 1 Aim token or 1 Dodge token.

name: A Machine Made For Killing
text: When a unit is issued an Order with this card, it gains 1 Aim token and gains Demoralize 3 and Steady this Round.

name: Aerial Assault
text:
When a unit with the Jump X keyword is issued an Order with this card, it may make a [Action] Jump 2 action.
This Round, when an allied unit that has a faceup Order token and the Jump X keyword attacks, it gains Death From Above until the end of the Round.

name: Aggression
text: When issuing Orders with this card, you may choose to not issue up to 2 Orders. Then, for each Order not issued in this way, choose a different allied Mercenary unit within Range 3 of the nominated Commander. Each chosen unit gains 1 Aim token.

name: Aggressive Negotiations
text: When a unit is issued an Order with this card, that unit may make a Speed-1 Move, gain 1 Aim token, gain 1 Dodge token, or gain 1 Surge token.

name: Air Support
text: Once this Round, at the end of an allied Commander 's Activation or an allied Field Commander unit's Activation, that unit may make an attack using the weapon below.

name: Battlefield Reconnaissance
text: This Round, when creating your Pass Pool, add a number of additional Advantage tokens equal to the current Round number.

name: Both Hunter and Prey
text: At the end of The Armorerʼs first Activation this Round, she may suffer 1 Wound. If she does, shuffle her Order token into the Order Pool. During The Armorerʼs second Activation this Round, she makes 1 fewer action.

name: Brains and Brawn
text: This Round, each time an allied Leia Organa makes a Ranged attack, if Chewbacca has LOS to and is within Range 3 of the defender during the Form Attack Pool step, add 1 of Chewbacca's Ranged weapons to the Attack Pool.

name: Close Formation

requirement.text: Clan Kryze Commander or Clan Kryze Operative

requirementText: Clan Kryze Commander or Clan Kryze Operative
text: This Round, while an allied Clan Kryze unit is within Range 1 of another allied Clan Kryze unit, those units gain Precise 1 and Outmaneuver.

name: Concussive Blast
text:
When Iden Versio starts her Activation this Round, she makes a Recover action.
During Iden Versio's Activation this Round, she gains the weapon below.

name: Courage of the Rebellion
text: When an allied unit is issued an Order with this card, that unit may make a Recover action.

name: Deploy The Garrison
text: At the start of this Roundʼs Activation Phase, choose up to 2 allied Trooper units that have faceup Order tokens. Each chosen unit may make a free Standby action.

name: Double the Fall
text:
At the start of the Activation Phase this Round, if Count Dooku has a faceup Order token, you may return it to your Order Pool.
If you do, choose up to 2 enemy units within Range 2 and return their Order tokens to the opposing player's Order Pool.

name: Evasive Action
text:
Choose up to 2 allied Commander or Operative units that have the Speeder X keyword. Each chosen unit issues an Order to itself and gains Outmaneuver this Round.
Additionally, this Round, allied Support and Heavy Vehicle units have Nimble while they are within Range 2 of an allied Commander or Operative unit that has the Speeder X keyword.

name: Evasive Maneuvers
text: When an allied Vehicle unit is issued an Order with this card, it gains 1 Dodge token. Allied Vehicle units gain Nimble this Round.

name: Family Reunion
text:
Ahsoka Tano gains Teamwork: Sabine Wren this Round.
At the start of Ahsoka Tano's next Activation, Sabine Wren may make a Speed-2 Move.
At the start of Sabine Wren's next Activation, Ahsoka Tano may make a Speed-2 Move.

name: Fear And Dead Men
text: This Round, when Darth Vader suffers 1 or more Wounds from an enemy attack, after the effect is resolved, the attacking unit suffers an equal number of Wounds.

name: Fight Another Day
text:
This Round, Gar Saxon cannot issue Orders to allied units that are not within Range 1 of him.
When a unit is issued an Order with this card, it gains 1 Dodge token.
Gar Saxon and allied Special Forces units gain Outmaneuver this Round.

name: Full of Surprises
text:
Luke Skywalker gains 1 Dodge token.
Until the end of the Round, each time Luke Skywalker defends, he rolls a number of additional white defense dice during the Roll Defense Dice step equal to his courage minus the number of Suppression tokens he has.

name: Get In Position
text: When an allied Wookiee Trooper unit is issued an Order with this card, if a Commander Wookiee Trooper unit issued that Order, the Ordered unit gains Agile 1 this Round.

name: Have I Ever Let You Down?
text: This Round, each time a unit that was issued an Order with this card suffers 1 or more Wounds from an enemy attack while within Range 1 of Clone Commander Cody, after the attack is resolved, if Clone Commander Cody is within Range 4 of the attacking enemy unit and has LOS to it, he may make an attack against that unit.

name: Hiding in Plain Sight
text:
You must nominate an Ewok Commander.
If you cannot nominate an Ewok Commander, you cannot play this card.
Units issued an Order with this card gain Inconspicuous this Round.

name: His Eminence
text: Maul gains 1 Dodge token. Each other Trooper unit within Range 1 of Maul gains 1 Suppression token. Until the end of the Round, each time an allied Trooper unit starts its Activation within Range 1 of Maul, it skips its Rally step and cannot be Suppressed or Panicked this Round.

name: I Am Fear
text: At the start of Asajj Ventress' next Activation, she makes a Recover action. At the end of Asajj Ventress' next Activation, she may make an attack using the weapon below.

name: I don't Believe in Chance
text:
When Plo Koon is issued an Order with this card, he may make 2 [Free action] Distract free Actions.
Until the end of the Round, when another allied unit issued an Order with this card starts its Activation within Range 2 of Plo Koon, Plo Koon may make a Speed-1 Move.

name: I Like Those Odds
text:
Din Djarin gains 1 Aim token.
This Round, when Din Djarin makes an Attack action, after that Attack action is resolved, he may make an attack against a different unit.

name: I Smell Fear... and it Smells Good
text:
Choose up to 2 enemy units. Each chosen unit gains 1 Ploy token.
This Round, at the start of each allied unit's Activation, you may choose an enemy unit that has 1 or more Ploy tokens. If you do, remove 1 of those Ploy tokens and resolve 1 of the effects below:
• The chosen unit loses 1 green token.
• The chosen unit gains 2 Suppression tokens.
• If the chosen unit has a faceup Order token,
shuffle it into that Opponent's Order Pool.

name: I'm in Control
text: At the start and end of Cad Baneʼs next Activation, he may remove any number of Suppression tokens. For each Suppression token removed in this way, choose another unit within Range 2 of him. The chosen unit gains 1 Suppression token. Each time an enemy Trooper unit gains 1 or more Suppression tokens in this way, if it has no Immobilize tokens, it gains 1 Immobilize token.

name: I'm Sorry Master, I Didn't Catch That
text: Anakin Skywalker gains Gunslinger this Round and gains 2 Aim tokens or 2 Surge tokens. When Anakin Skywalker makes an attack this Round, after all Attack Pools are resolved, he may make a Speed-2 Move.

name: Impromptu Immolation
text: When R2-D2 makes an attack this Round, after the attack is resolved, he may make a free Move action. During R2-D2's next Activation, he gains the weapon below.
